originalTitle: Wall Street ends sharply higher, lifted by soaring Microsoft
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks ended sharply higher on Thursday, with the Dow gaining more than one percent, the S&P 500 climbing one-and-two-thirds percent and the Nasdaq rallying more than two-and-three-quarters percent. :: Microsoft Shares of Microsoft soared more than 15% to log their biggest daily percentage gain in 18 years, after the tech giant gave a stellar forecast that eased fears about massive spending on AI infrastructure. That boosted overall market sentiment, says Mary Ann Bartels, chief investment strategist at Sanctuary Wealth. “I think the real focus is on Microsoft and their earnings report. There's been a lot of concern about the hyperscalers, the money that they're spending and whether or not they're going to get a return on their capital. And Microsoft eased their concerns. Their spend on their cloud they didn't raise, and their return on their cloud was positive. So the market's really hyper focused, I think, that things aren't that bad.” :: Amazon After the close, Amazon gave investors more reason to cheer when it topped market expectations for quarterly cloud revenue growth on the back of surging enterprise AI spending, signaling the company's hefty investments were bearing fruit. Its shares, up nearly 4% at the close, surged more than 8% in extended trading. Also after the bell, Apple reported sales and profits that beat Wall Street expectations, fueled by its customers snapping up iPhones and MacBooks amid price increases across the consumer electronics sector. Its shares, however, dipped more than 2% in extended trading. :: Meta Platforms And shares Meta tumbled 8% after the social media heavyweight reported a 91% drop in second-quarter free cash flow, a sign that its costly AI buildout was causing a financial strain.

chineseTitle: 受微软飙升提振，华尔街股市大幅收高
chineseSummary: 故事：美国股市周四大幅收高，道琼斯指数上涨超过百分之一，标准普尔 500 指数上涨三分之二，纳斯达克指数上涨超过百分之二又四分之三。微软股价飙升超过 15%，创 18 年来最大单日百分比涨幅，此前这家科技巨头做出了出色的预测，缓解了人们对人工智能基础设施大规模支出的担忧。 Sanctuary Wealth 首席投资策略师玛丽·安·巴特尔斯 (Mary Ann Bartels) 表示，这提振了整体市场情绪。 “我认为真正的焦点是微软和他们的盈利报告。人们对超大规模企业、他们所花的钱以及他们是否能获得资本回报有很多担忧。微软缓解了他们的担忧。他们没有筹集云上的支出，而且他们在云上的回报是积极的。所以我认为，市场确实高度关注，情况并没有那么糟糕。” :: 亚马逊收盘后，由于企业人工智能支出激增，亚马逊季度云收入增长超出了市场预期，这给投资者带来了更多欢呼的理由，这表明该公司的巨额投资正在取得成果。其股价收盘上涨近4%，在盘后交易中飙升逾8%。同样在盘后，苹果公司公布的销售额和利润超出了华尔街的预期，这得益于其客户在消费电子产品行业价格上涨的情况下抢购 iPhone 和 MacBook。然而，其股价在盘后交易中下跌了 2% 以上。 :: Meta 平台和股价 在这家社交媒体重量级公司报告第二季度自由现金流下降 91% 后，Meta 股价下跌 8%，这表明其昂贵的人工智能建设正在造成财务紧张。
